verificationNote: Based on preliminary student experience. Confirm the current procedure with the institution before relying on these steps.
preparationChecklist: Confirm whether the college-prescribed application form is required.
Confirm whether a payment challan is required.
Ask which identity proof and supporting documents are required.
Check whether originals, photocopies, or payment receipts must be submitted.

procedure.instruction: Confirm the current application procedure with the relevant college office.
Complete the required form and payment process only after confirming the current instructions.
Check all required documents and submit them at the designated location.
Keep any acknowledgement or receipt and confirm how the certificate will be issued.
